notes: Direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) for homepage/robots/sitemaps, Playwright (tier 2) to confirm client-rendered Unbxd search counts; no bot protection encountered, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: (1) top nav - 6 department tabs (Bedroom, Decor, Kitchen, Furnishings, Tableware, Gifting) plus one 'Sale' tab; no Bestsellers/Popular/Trending tab exists. (2) Homepage carousels: a section literally titled 'Furniture Bestsellers' exists, but every one of its banner links resolves to a plain ordinary category browse page (e.g. /in/en/c/bedroom-beds-kingbeds, /in/en/c/diningroom-diningchairs, /in/en/c/livingroom-tables-centertables) - not a curated bestseller/popularity listing, just themed marketing creative pointing at regular categories, so it fails the brief's 'not just a page that mentions bestselling products' test and was excluded. (3) Site's own listingPageSortBy config (embedded in __NEXT_DATA__) only offers New Arrivals/Discount/Price-Low/Price-High/Relevance/Alphabetical sorts - no popularity/bestselling sort exists anywhere on the storefront. (4) Site search (Unbxd backend) for 'bestseller', 'best seller', 'popular', and 'trending' all rendered numberOfProducts:0 (confirmed via Playwright since the count is client-rendered) - zero genuine results for any bestseller/popularity term. (5) Sitemaps (decor.xml, livingroom.xml, kitchen.xml, bedroom.xml, diningroom.xml, toppages.xml) grepped for bestsell/top-sell/popular/trending/customer-favorite slugs - 0 hits; remaining department sitemaps (bathandlaundry/furnishing/outdoor/homeoffice/gifts/appliances/customizedfurniture/refurbished/sitemap_1) hit HTTP 429 rate-limiting on the /sitemap/* path after the first several fetches and were not retried (no sleep/backoff loop per brief); the department sitemaps already checked show the site's category-URL naming scheme never encodes merchandising concepts like bestsellers into slugs, so this is not expected to change the conclusion. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers/Top-Sellers/Popular-Products/Customer-Favorites PLP exists on this storefront.
